'The lever is spent' and 'the lever is not connected' have different successors, and only the second is supported.
A budget-branch closure is an argument about TRANSFER RATE, not about no-movement. The mean rose; saying it did not is the shape that gets an artifact re-adjudicated later.

A run pair can be budget-only in the DRIVER and not in the RUN. Here substrate and machine both moved; the OFF and rawfield tracks being bit-identical is what bounds the damage, and the anchor track's wobble across nominally-identical cells is what SUPPLIES the noise floor -- so the confound and its remedy were both already in the cells.

A criterion computed from the same local variable as a precondition (C3 / P6 here, bit-identically) is not a second check. Count the informative criteria before reading '2 of 3 passed' as corroboration.
